title: Baltic Freight 3: A bad day
lead: Not every day is easy. A customer calls with a complaint, you help a truck at the border and you plan a shift with the warehouse team.
how: You work at Baltic Freight, a logistics company. Choose what you say.
Green ✓ is right. Red ✕ is not this one. You can try again and you will see what to say. Right the first time? You get a star ★.
Tap an underlined word to see what it means.

words.definition: broken or hurt, not in good condition
words.example: Last month a truck arrived at a shop with damaged boxes.

words.definition: a statement that you are not happy about something
words.example: The customer was angry and sent a complaint.

words.definition: to say that you are sorry
words.example: The manager apologized and asked the driver what happened.

words.definition: the cause of something that happens
words.example: They look for the reason and find a solution.

words.definition: a way to solve a problem
words.example: They look for the reason and find a solution.

words.definition: an official instruction about what you must or must not do
words.example: The manager also made a new rule: drivers must tie the boxes more carefully.
When goods cross a border, they need documents.

words.definition: a person with a lot of knowledge in one area
words.example: So a logistics specialist always checks every document twice before the truck leaves.
When goods cross a border, they need documents.

words.definition: a paper that shows what you must pay for goods
words.example: The most important ones are the invoice and the customs declaration.

words.definition: an official statement about the goods that you bring
words.example: The most important ones are the invoice and the customs declaration.

words.definition: the office that checks goods that enter a country
words.example: The most important ones are the invoice and the customs declaration.

words.definition: a tax that you pay on goods from another country
lessons that teach you how to do a job
words.example: New workers get training before they start.

words.definition: a period of work, for example morning or night
words.example: A team leader organizes the shifts, so there are always enough workers.

words.definition: an event where people come together to talk
words.example: Every week the leader holds a short meeting.
